questions.question_english: A school Principal is processing a medical bill for a subordinate under CS(MA) rules. The employee purchased an expensive “food supplement” prescribed by a private doctor. According to the rules, how should this item be handled in the reimbursement claim?
options_english: Excluded, as food supplements and tonics are inadmissible under rules
Reimbursed fully in all cases, provided it was formally prescribed by a registered physician
Option C
Option D
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is 'Excluded, as food supplements and tonics are inadmissible under rules'. Statutory lists of inadmissible items under medical attendance rules strictly prohibit reimbursement for general nutritional supplements, tonics, energy drinks, baby foods, and cosmetic preparations. Even if prescribed by a registered doctor, such items cannot be reimbursed, and administrative authorities must deduct them from total claim amounts.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। चिकित्सा उपस्थिति नियमों के तहत अवैध वस्तुओं की वैधानिक सूचियाँ सामान्य पोषण संबंधी सप्लीमेंट, टॉनिक, ऊर्जा पेय, बेबी फूड और कॉस्मेटिक तैयारियों के लिए प्रतिपूर्ति को सख्ती से प्रतिबंधित करती हैं। भले ही इसे एक पंजीकृत चिकित्सक द्वारा निर्धारित किया गया हो, ऐसे आइटमों की प्रतिपूर्ति नहीं की जा सकती है, और प्रशासनिक प्राधिकरणों को इन्हें कुल दावे की राशि से घटाना चाहिए।
key_facts: Statutory lists prohibit reimbursement for food supplements.
Printed answer key: (a) Excluded, as food supplements and tonics are inadmissible under rules.

questions.question_english: The treatment rates agreed upon between the Government and empanelled hospitals are commonly referred to as:

questions.explanation_english: Standard negotiated fees approved by the government for various medical investigations, inpatient bed occupancy, routine consultations, and surgical procedures at empanelled private facilities are formally termed package rates. questions.question_english: What is the fundamental difference between the CS(MA) Rules and the CGHS?
options_english: CS(MA) applies exclusively to retired pensioners, whereas CGHS is strictly mandatory for all active serving employees
CS(MA) operates on a commercial health insurance model, whereas CGHS is fully funded with no monthly contributions
CS(MA) covers specialized medical treatment abroad, whereas CGHS covers treatment only within designated cities
CS(MA) applies in non-CGHS areas via reimbursement, while CGHS provides care directly via wellness centres
questions.explanation_english: The fundamental operational distinction is geographical and structural. Central Services Medical Attendance Rules operate in nonscheme zones through an Authorised Medical Attendant network with post-treatment financial reimbursement, whereas the Health Scheme functions in notified cities providing direct outpatient care through network wellness centres and empanelled facilities.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। CS(MA) नियमों और CGHS के बीच का मूलभूत अंतर भौगोलिक और संरचनात्मक है। केंद्रीय सेवा चिकित्सा उपस्थिति नियम गैर-योजना क्षेत्रों में अधिकृत चिकित्सा अधिकारी नेटवर्क के माध्यम से कार्य करते हैं, जबकि स्वास्थ्य योजना अधिसूचित शहरों में सीधे आउट पेशेंट देखभाल प्रदान करती है।

questions.question_english: In case of an absolute emergency, a CGHS beneficiary has the right to undergo treatment at:

Only officially CGHS empanelled private hospitals in the region
Only municipal dispensaries and clinics managed by local civic bodies

questions.explanation_english: In severe, life-threatening emergency situations where immediate medical intervention is critical to save life, a beneficiary is permitted to obtain emergency admission at any nearby healthcare facility, including non-empanelled private hospitals. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। गंभीर, जीवन-धातक आपातकालीन स्थितियों में जहाँ तत्काल चिकित्सा हस्तक्षेप जीवन को बचाने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण होता है, एक लाभार्थी को किसी भी निकटवर्ती स्वास्थ्य सुविधा में आपातकालीन भर्ती कराने की अनुमति होती है, जिसमें गैर-अनुबंधित निजी अस्पताल भी शामिल हैं। बाद में पुनर्भुगतान मानक पैकेज दरों के आधार पर आपातकालीन सत्यापन और वित्तीय सीमाओं के अधीन होता है।

questions.question_english: What is the fundamental requirement for a serving Central Government employee to be eligible for CGHS coverage?
options_english: The employee must have completed a minimum of 10 years of service.
The employee must be a Gazetted Officer.
The employee must be residing in a CGHS covered area.

questions.explanation_english: Mandatory participation in the Central Government Health Scheme for serving personnel depends primarily on territorial jurisdiction. An employee whose official headquarters or residential address falls within a notified scheme coverage zone must enroll in the scheme, whereas those stationed outside such notified areas remain governed by medical attendance rules instead.

questions.question_english: Identify the correct pair regarding ward entitlement based on basic pay under CGHS guidelines:
options_english: Basic Pay up to ₹47,600 - Entitled to Private Ward accommodation
Basic Pay from ₹47,601 to ₹63,100 - Semi-Private Ward
Basic Pay ₹63,101 and above - Entitled to General Ward accommodation
All Group A Gazetted Officers - Entitled to Deluxe Suite accommodation
questions.explanation_english: Under pay matrix guidelines for ward entitlement, basic pay ranging from forty-seven thousand six hundred one rupees to sixty-three thousand rupees per month entitles the beneficiary to Semi-Private Ward accommodation in empanelled hospitals. Lower pay levels qualify for General Ward, while basic pay above sixty-three thousand qualifies for Private Ward.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। मूल वेतन के लिए वार्ड अधिकारिता के तहत, चालीस हजार छह सौ एक रुपये से लेकर साठ हजार रुपये प्रति माह तक का मूल वेतन लाभार्थी को समर्पित अस्पतालों में सेमी-प्राइवेट वार्ड आवास के लिए पात्र बनाता है। निम्न वेतन स्तर सामान्य वार्ड के लिए योग्य होते हैं, जबकि साठ हजार से अधिक का मूल वेतन निजी वार्ड के लिए योग्य होता है।
key_facts: Basic Pay from ₹47,601 to ₹63,100 entitles to Semi-Private Ward.
Lower pay levels qualify for General Ward.
Basic Pay above ₹63,000 qualifies for Private Ward.
Printed answer key: (B) Basic Pay from ₹47,601 to ₹63,100 - Semi-Private Ward

questions.question_english: Which of the following conditions is legally classified as a “medical emergency” under CGHS guidelines?
options_english: Option A
Option B
Acute Myocardial Infarction (Heart Attack)
Option D
questions.explanation_english: Official guidelines define a medical emergency as a sudden, unforeseen clinical condition posing an immediate threat to life or organ function requiring immediate intervention. Acute Myocardial Infarction qualifies as a genuine emergency, whereas routine elective surgeries, planned dental cleaning, and elective joint replacements do not meet emergency criteria.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। आधिकारिक दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार, चिकित्सा आपातकाल को एक अचानक, अप्रत्याशित नैदानिक स्थिति के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है जो जीवन या अंग के कार्य के लिए तत्काल खतरा उत्पन्न करती है और जिसके लिए तत्काल हस्तक्षेप की आवश्यकता होती है। अक्यूट मायोकार्डियल इन्फार्क्शन एक वास्तविक आपातकाल के रूप में योग्य है, जबकि नियमित चुनावी सर्जरी, नियोजित दंत सफाई और चुनावी संयुक्त प्रतिस्थापन आपातकालीन मानदंडों को पूरा नहीं करते हैं।
key_facts: Medical emergencies require immediate intervention.
Acute Myocardial Infarction is classified as a medical emergency.
Routine elective surgeries do not qualify as emergencies.
Printed answer key: (C) Acute Myocardial Infarction (Heart Attack)
